basis: Inherited cholestasis classified under inborn bilirubin metabolism disorders; hepatic fibrosis in 4/5. Pruritus alone does not establish skin damage.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: supplied ancestry explicitly classifies this cholestatic disorder as an inborn disorder of bilirubin metabolism.

basis: Defining skin and skeletal disease; progressive arterial damage affects most over the course; hearing impairment 80-99%. Endocrine and oral abnormalities omitted by cap.

decisions.cardiovascular: involved: progressive arterial degeneration affects most over the typical course; skin and skeletal abnormalities establish the clinical syndrome.

basis: Mitochondrial enteropathy with defining renal insufficiency; hepatic steatosis is a defining feature, frequency unreported. Later neurologic, ocular and hearing frequencies are unknown.

decisions.renal: primary: renal insufficiency is explicitly included among the syndrome's defining manifestations, rather than described as a later complication.

basis: Deep connective-tissue tumor. Familial APC-associated HPO frequencies do not represent the whole umbrella; direct bowel or subcutaneous damage in >=30% is not established.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: familial APC-enriched annotations do not establish direct bowel damage in >=30% across sporadic and familial desmoid tumors; polyposis is separate.
decisions.dermatologic: none: deep fibroblastic masses or palpable subcutaneous nodules do not establish skin/subcutis damage in >=30% across the umbrella.

basis: Malignant tumor arising in the spleen, assigned to the haematologic axis; vascular histology alone does not add another organ axis.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: the specified organ of origin is the spleen; endothelial histology alone does not establish a separate cardiovascular disease site.

basis: Oxidative phosphorylation disorder; cerebellar atrophy 4/4, liver dysfunction 2/2, optic atrophy 3/3. Hearing loss 2/3 and cardiomyopathy 1/2 omitted by cap.

decisions.hepatic: involved: liver dysfunction and steatosis each occur in 2/2 assessed patients, as direct manifestations of the defining mitochondrial metabolic disorder.
decisions.neurologic: involved: cerebellar atrophy in 4/4 and developmental delay in 3/3 establish common direct neurologic injury secondary to the metabolic defect.

basis: Defining optic atrophy and neurologic degeneration; ancestry identifies an inborn mitochondrial metabolism disorder. Constipation and dysphagia do not establish direct gut injury.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: supplied ancestry identifies an inborn mitochondrial metabolism disorder; this classification, rather than the OPA1 gene alone, supports the mechanism axis.

basis: Inborn beta-alanine metabolism disorder explicitly defined by neurotoxic accumulation with encephalopathy and convulsions; numerical frequencies are unavailable.

decisions.neurologic: primary: neurotoxicity, encephalopathy and convulsions are explicitly defining manifestations of the described disease.

basis: Hereditary alveolar proteinosis with defective surfactant clearance and impaired gas exchange; the supplied phenotype establishes pulmonary disease.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: CSF2RA-related alveolar proteinosis reflects defective macrophage surfactant clearance; the metabolism wording alone does not establish a metabolic disorder.

basis: Dental enamel demineralization belongs to the gastrointestinal axis. Acid production by resident plaque biofilm does not by itself establish an infection of enamel.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: enamel-limited caries is biofilm-driven acid demineralization; bacterial participation alone does not establish an infection or immune-mediated disease.
